pairs.name: Ancient Apparition
pairs.reason: Ice Blast prevents you from healing from Spirit Siphon and Exorcism which is the most reliant way of Death Prophet to survive during teamfights.

pairs.name: Anti-Mage
pairs.reason: Your high mana pool and frequent mana usage will make you a prime target for Anti Mage with his Mana Void.

pairs.name: Doom
pairs.reason: Doom is going to stop you from casting spells which will make you useless during teamfights unless you have already casted Exorcism before that. You cannot heal during Doom.
